scripts.dev:backend: cd backend && PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1 .venv/bin/python -m uvicorn app.main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port $(node -p "require('./ports.json').backend") --reload --log-level info
scripts.ensure:sidecar: test -f src-tauri/binaries/.build-id && grep -q builtin-llm-v1 src-tauri/binaries/.build-id && test -x src-tauri/binaries/python-backend/python-backend || npm run build:sidecar
scripts.kill:backend: for p in $(lsof -ti tcp:$(node -p "require('./ports.json').backend") -sTCP:LISTEN); do case "$(ps -o command= -p $p)" in *python-backend*|*uvicorn*app.main*) kill $p; sleep 1;; esac; done; true
scripts.dev: npm run kill:backend && npm run ensure:sidecar && ./scripts/dev.sh
scripts.build:sidecar: cd backend && python3 -m venv .venv && PIP_REQUIRE_HASHES=0 .venv/bin/pip install -r requirements.txt pyinstaller && PIP_REQUIRE_HASHES=0 .venv/bin/python -m PyInstaller --noconfirm python-backend.spec && rm -rf ../src-tauri/binaries/python-backend ../src-tauri/binaries/python-backend-* && mkdir -p ../src-tauri/binaries && cp -RL dist/python-backend ../src-tauri/binaries/python-backend && echo builtin-llm-v1 > ../src-tauri/binaries/.build-id
scripts.build:all: npm run build:next && npm run build:sidecar && npm run tauri build
